review_description: The installation was quick and the team is polite and punctual.The customer service is good and the grid connection was organised.Already seeing the potential benefits of my solar system.

WR Electrical and Solar were efficient to provide a quote and arrange an installation time. They were punctual and completed the necessary paperwork. Unfortunately in the installation process around 12 screw holes were made in the ceiling of our main living area which has high ceilings. This was very disappointing for us as we had just purchased the house. They patched up the holes and took $200 off the price. Overall it appears to be installed well and at a good price. It is just very disappointing for us that we had screw holes made in our ceiling.
Brendan and his crew did an excellent job. No pressure sales and great after sales support.
